main_text.p: nice pro afferendo Antichristi dominatu pugnarent: Regnū draconis manet, qui est diabolus ac Satanas, Apoc.20. & in eo Papæ quadraginta collocātur. Ab illo Innocētio ad Iuliū secundū, qui formidabilissimus bellator extitit, & immitissimus hominū Christianorū peremptor, enumerantur etiā quadraginta Papæ: &Regnum locustarū id erat sub Abaddone, qui perditor nominatur, Apo.9. Iulius autē in huius regni fine, proiectis S.Petri clauibus in Tyberis flumen, rubiginoso Pauli gladio accinctus, in pugnam aduersus Gallū & alios principes Christianos prodijt. Et ita quintus Ordo, capit omnes ab hoc Iulio, usq; ad Pauli quarti finem, per octo Papas, omnium̄sq; posterorum tempora usq; ad Christi iudicis ultionem: & est occasus regni Papistici, sine ui, sine manibus, solo Dei uerbo & flatu diuini spiritus. 2. Thessa. 2. & Dan. 8. In summa, ita historiam hanc totam digessi, ut omnes Romanos episcopos, quatuor equis in Reuelatione Ioannis comparauerim: simplices & candidos, albo equo : Archiepiscopos ac Patriarchas, rufo : Papas & Antichristos ad Syluեstrum secundum, nigro: & ab illo ad Iulium secundum, ac deinceps, cum suis monachorum, fraterculorum & missatorum agminibus, qui ad Papalis regni defensionem, liuore & maleuolētia suffusi, omnibus opibus ac uiribus incūbunt, pallido cōs4rens.

page.notes: Right margin marks: "c." beside the first lines, "4." beside the Iulio paragraph, "c." beside the Ordo paragraph, "5." beside the Papas paragraph, and "c." beside the diabolus lines; left margin marks are small reference marks only. The printed reference "Apo.9" and the marks are transcribed as printed. The word "Syluեstrum" contains a damaged letter and is transcribed approximately; "Abaddone" and "Sylvestrum" are uncertain readings. The line ending "pallido cōs / rens" is a catchword-style split at the foot: "cōs" is printed as the last word and "rens" as the continuation at the bottom. The right-hand marginal reference symbols are partly obscured and are not fully legible.
